statement: A quality control unit exists with responsibility and authority to approve or reject all components, containers, closures, in-process materials, packaging material, labeling and drug products.
quote: There shall be a quality control unit that shall have the responsibility and authority to approve or reject all components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, packaging material, labeling, and drug products

statement: The quality control unit has authority to review production records to confirm no errors occurred, or that any errors that occurred were fully investigated.
quote: the authority to review production records to assure that no errors have occurred or, if errors have occurred, that they have been fully investigated
findings: quote has condition wording the statement lacks

statement: The quality control unit approves or rejects drug products made, processed, packed or held under contract by another company.
quote: The quality control unit shall be responsible for approving or rejecting drug products manufactured, processed, packed, or held under contract by another company.

statement: Adequate lab facilities are available to the quality control unit for testing and approving or rejecting components, containers, closures, packaging materials, in-process materials and drug products.
quote: Adequate laboratory facilities for the testing and approval (or rejection) of components, drug product containers, closures, packaging materials, in-process materials, and drug products shall be available to the quality control unit.

statement: The quality control unit approves or rejects every procedure or specification affecting the identity, strength, quality and purity of the drug product.
quote: The quality control unit shall have the responsibility for approving or rejecting all procedures or specifications impacting on the identity, strength, quality, and purity of the drug product.

statement: The quality control unit's responsibilities and procedures are written down, and those written procedures are followed.
quote: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit shall be in writing; such written procedures shall be followed.

statement: Everyone who manufactures, processes, packs or holds a drug product has the education, training and/or experience needed for their assigned functions.
quote: Each person engaged in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall have education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof, to enable that person to perform the assigned functions.

statement: Employees are trained in the specific operations they perform and in CGMP (including these regulations and the required written procedures) as relevant to their functions.
quote: Training shall be in the particular operations that the employee performs and in current good manufacturing practice (including the current good manufacturing practice regulations in this chapter and written procedures required by these regulations) as they relate to the employee's functions.

statement: CGMP training is given by qualified trainers, on a continuing basis, often enough that staff stay familiar with the CGMP requirements that apply to them.
quote: Training in current good manufacturing practice shall be conducted by qualified individuals on a continuing basis and with sufficient frequency to assure that employees remain familiar with CGMP requirements applicable to them.

statement: Supervisors of manufacture, processing, packing or holding have the education, training and/or experience to perform their functions so that the product's safety, identity, strength, quality and purity are assured.
quote: Each person responsible for supervising the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall have the education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof, to perform assigned functions in such a manner as to provide assurance that the drug product has the safety, identity, strength, quality, and purity that it purports or is represented to possess.

statement: Enough qualified staff are available to perform and supervise manufacture, processing, packing or holding of each drug product.
quote: There shall be an adequate number of qualified personnel to perform and supervise the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of each drug product.

statement: Buildings used to make, process, pack or hold drug products are of suitable size, construction and location to ease cleaning, maintenance and proper operation.
quote: Any building or buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be of suitable size, construction and location to facilitate cleaning, maintenance, and proper operations.

statement: Buildings have adequate space for orderly placement of equipment and materials to prevent mixups between components, containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials or drug products, and to prevent contamination.
quote: Any such building shall have adequate space for the orderly placement of equipment and materials to prevent mixups between different components, drug product containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials, or drug products, and to prevent contamination.

statement: The flow of components, containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials and drug products through the buildings is designed to prevent contamination.
quote: The flow of components, drug product containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials, and drug products through the building or buildings shall be designed to prevent contamination.

statement: Operations take place in specifically defined areas of adequate size.
quote: Operations shall be performed within specifically defined areas of adequate size.

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for receipt, identification, storage and withholding of components, containers, closures and labeling pending QC sampling, testing or examination before release.
quote: Receipt, identification, storage, and withholding from use of components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling, pending the appropriate sampling, testing, or examination by the quality control unit before release for manufacturing or packaging
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for holding rejected components, containers, closures and labeling until disposition.
quote: Holding rejected components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling before disposition
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for storing released components, containers, closures and labeling.
quote: Storage of released components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for storing in-process materials.
quote: Storage of in-process materials
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for manufacturing and processing operations.
quote: Manufacturing and processing operations
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for packaging and labeling operations.
quote: Packaging and labeling operations
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for quarantine storage of drug products before release.
quote: Quarantine storage before release of drug products
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for storing released drug products.
quote: Storage of drug products after release
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups
findings: quote has after wording the statement lacks

statement: Separate or defined areas or other controls are provided for control and laboratory operations.
quote: Control and laboratory operations
condition: necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Aseptic processing areas have, as appropriate, smooth, hard, easily cleanable floors, walls and ceilings.
quote: Floors, walls, and ceilings of smooth, hard surfaces that are easily cleanable
condition: aseptic processing, as appropriate; necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Aseptic processing areas have, as appropriate, temperature and humidity controls.
quote: Temperature and humidity controls
condition: aseptic processing, as appropriate; necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Aseptic processing areas have, as appropriate, HEPA-filtered air supply under positive pressure, whether flow is laminar or not.
quote: An air supply filtered through high-efficiency particulate air filters under positive pressure, regardless of whether flow is laminar or nonlaminar
condition: aseptic processing, as appropriate; necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Aseptic processing areas have, as appropriate, a system for monitoring environmental conditions.
quote: A system for monitoring environmental conditions
condition: aseptic processing, as appropriate; necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Aseptic processing areas have, as appropriate, a system for cleaning and disinfecting the room and equipment to achieve aseptic conditions.
quote: A system for cleaning and disinfecting the room and equipment to produce aseptic conditions
condition: aseptic processing, as appropriate; necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Aseptic processing areas have, as appropriate, a system for maintaining any equipment used to control aseptic conditions.
quote: A system for maintaining any equipment used to control the aseptic conditions
condition: aseptic processing, as appropriate; necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

statement: Penicillin manufacture, processing and packing are done in facilities separate from those used for other human drug products.
quote: Operations relating to the manufacture, processing, and packing of penicillin shall be performed in facilities separate from those used for other drug products for human use.

statement: Equipment and utensils are cleaned, maintained and, as appropriate to the drug, sanitized and/or sterilized at appropriate intervals to prevent malfunction or contamination affecting product safety, identity, strength, quality or purity beyond established requirements.
quote: Equipment and utensils shall be cleaned, maintained, and, as appropriate for the nature of the drug, sanitized and/or sterilized at appropriate intervals to prevent malfunctions or contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug product beyond the official or other established requirements.
condition: sanitize/sterilize as appropriate for the drug

statement: Written procedures for cleaning and maintaining equipment and utensils used for drug products are established and followed.
quote: Written procedures shall be established and followed for cleaning and maintenance of equipment, including utensils, used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product.

statement: Equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures assign responsibility for cleaning and maintaining equipment.
quote: Assignment of responsibility for cleaning and maintaining equipment

statement: Equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures set maintenance and cleaning schedules, including sanitizing schedules where appropriate.
quote: Maintenance and cleaning schedules, including, where appropriate, sanitizing schedules

statement: Equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures describe in enough detail the methods, equipment and materials for cleaning and maintenance, and how to disassemble and reassemble equipment as needed for proper cleaning and maintenance.
quote: A description in sufficient detail of the methods, equipment, and materials used in cleaning and maintenance operations, and the methods of disassembling and reassembling equipment as necessary to assure proper cleaning and maintenance

statement: Equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures require removal or obliteration of previous batch identification.
quote: Removal or obliteration of previous batch identification

statement: Equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures require protection of clean equipment from contamination before use.
quote: Protection of clean equipment from contamination prior to use

statement: Equipment cleaning and maintenance procedures require inspection of equipment for cleanliness immediately before use.
quote: Inspection of equipment for cleanliness immediately before use

statement: Records of equipment maintenance, cleaning, sanitizing and inspection are kept as specified in 211.180 and 211.182.
quote: Records shall be kept of maintenance, cleaning, sanitizing, and inspection as specified in §§ 211.180 and 211.182.

statement: Each lot of components, containers and closures is held from use until sampled, tested or examined as appropriate and released by the quality control unit.
quote: Each lot of components, drug product containers, and closures shall be withheld from use until the lot has been sampled, tested, or examined, as appropriate, and released for use by the quality control unit.

statement: Representative samples are taken from each shipment of each lot for testing or examination.
quote: Representative samples of each shipment of each lot shall be collected for testing or examination.

statement: The number of containers sampled and the amount taken per container are based on appropriate criteria such as statistical criteria for variability, confidence and precision, the supplier's quality history, and quantity needed for analysis and for reserve where 211.170 requires it.
quote: The number of containers to be sampled, and the amount of material to be taken from each container, shall be based upon appropriate criteria such as statistical criteria for component variability, confidence levels, and degree of precision desired, the past quality history of the supplier, and the quantity needed for analysis and reserve where required by § 211.170.

statement: When sampling, selected component containers are cleaned when needed so no contaminants get into the component.
quote: The containers of components selected shall be cleaned when necessary in a manner to prevent introduction of contaminants into the component.

statement: When sampling, containers are opened, sampled and resealed so as to prevent contaminating their contents and other components, containers or closures.
quote: The containers shall be opened, sampled, and resealed in a manner designed to prevent contamination of their contents and contamination of other components, drug product containers, or closures.

statement: When sampling, sterile equipment and aseptic sampling techniques are used when necessary.
quote: Sterile equipment and aseptic sampling techniques shall be used when necessary.

statement: When a component must be sampled from top, middle and bottom of its container, those subdivisions are not composited for testing.
quote: If it is necessary to sample a component from the top, middle, and bottom of its container, such sample subdivisions shall not be composited for testing.
condition: if top, middle and bottom sampling is necessary

statement: Sample containers are identified so that material name, lot number, source container, sampling date and sampler's name can be determined.
quote: Sample containers shall be identified so that the following information can be determined: name of the material sampled, the lot number, the container from which the sample was taken, the date on which the sample was taken, and the name of the person who collected the sample.

statement: Containers that have been sampled are marked to show samples were removed.
quote: Containers from which samples have been taken shall be marked to show that samples have been removed from them.

statement: At least one test verifies the identity of each drug product component.
quote: At least one test shall be conducted to verify the identity of each component of a drug product.

statement: Specific identity tests are used for components where they exist.
quote: Specific identity tests, if they exist, shall be used.
findings: quote has condition wording the statement lacks

statement: Each component is tested against all appropriate written specifications for purity, strength and quality.
quote: Each component shall be tested for conformity with all appropriate written specifications for purity, strength, and quality.

statement: Instead of full testing, a supplier's report of analysis for a component may be accepted, provided the manufacturer does at least one specific identity test and establishes the reliability of the supplier's analyses by validating the supplier's results at appropriate intervals.
quote: In lieu of such testing by the manufacturer, a report of analysis may be accepted from the supplier of a component, provided that at least one specific identity test is conducted on such component by the manufacturer, and provided that the manufacturer establishes the reliability of the supplier's analyses through appropriate validation of the supplier's test results at appropriate intervals.
findings: quote has condition wording the statement lacks

statement: Containers and closures are tested against all appropriate written specifications.
quote: Containers and closures shall be tested for conformity with all appropriate written specifications.

statement: Instead of testing, a supplier's certificate of testing for containers/closures may be accepted, provided the manufacturer does at least a visual identification and establishes the reliability of the supplier's results by validating them at appropriate intervals.
quote: In lieu of such testing by the manufacturer, a certificate of testing may be accepted from the supplier, provided that at least a visual identification is conducted on such containers/closures by the manufacturer and provided that the manufacturer establishes the reliability of the supplier's test results through appropriate validation of the supplier's test results at appropriate intervals.
findings: quote has condition wording the statement lacks

statement: Components are examined microscopically when appropriate.
quote: When appropriate, components shall be microscopically examined.

statement: Each lot of component, container or closure liable to filth, insect infestation or other extraneous adulterants is examined against established specifications for that contamination.
quote: Each lot of a component, drug product container, or closure that is liable to contamination with filth, insect infestation, or other extraneous adulterant shall be examined against established specifications for such contamination.
condition: liable to filth or extraneous adulterant

statement: Each lot of component, container or closure with potential for microbial contamination objectionable for its intended use undergoes microbiological testing before use.
quote: Each lot of a component, drug product container, or closure with potential for microbiological contamination that is objectionable in view of its intended use shall be subjected to microbiological tests before use.

statement: A lot of components, containers or closures meeting the written specifications for identity, strength, quality and purity and related (d) tests may be approved and released for use.
quote: Any lot of components, drug product containers, or closures that meets the appropriate written specifications of identity, strength, quality, and purity and related tests under paragraph (d) of this section may be approved and released for use.

statement: Any lot of components, containers or closures not meeting specifications is rejected.
quote: Any lot of such material that does not meet such specifications shall be rejected.

statement: Maintain written production and process control procedures designed to ensure drug products have their claimed identity, strength, quality and purity.
quote: There shall be written procedures for production and process control designed to assure that the drug products have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.

statement: Ensure the production and process control procedures cover every requirement of this subpart.
quote: Such procedures shall include all requirements in this subpart.

statement: Have production and process control procedures, and any changes to them, drafted, reviewed and approved by the appropriate organizational units and then reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.
quote: These written procedures, including any changes, shall be drafted, reviewed, and approved by the appropriate organizational units and reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.

statement: Follow the written production and process control procedures when carrying out these functions and document each activity when it is performed.
quote: Written production and process control procedures shall be followed in the execution of the various production and process control functions and shall be documented at the time of performance.

statement: Record and justify every deviation from the written production and process control procedures.
quote: Any deviation from the written procedures shall be recorded and justified.

statement: Establish and follow appropriate written procedures to prevent objectionable microorganisms in non-sterile drug products.
quote: Appropriate written procedures, designed to prevent objectionable microorganisms in drug products not required to be sterile, shall be established and followed.
condition: drug products not required to be sterile

statement: Establish and follow appropriate written procedures to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products claimed to be sterile.
quote: Appropriate written procedures, designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile, shall be established and followed.
condition: drug products purporting to be sterile

statement: Include validation of all aseptic and sterilization processes in the procedures for sterile drug products.
quote: Such procedures shall include validation of all aseptic and sterilization processes.
condition: drug products purporting to be sterile

statement: Maintain a written stability testing program designed to assess the stability characteristics of drug products.
quote: There shall be a written testing program designed to assess the stability characteristics of drug products.

statement: Use stability testing results to set appropriate storage conditions and expiration dates.
quote: The results of such stability testing shall be used in determining appropriate storage conditions and expiration dates.

statement: Follow the written stability testing program.
quote: The written program shall be followed

statement: Include in the stability program sample sizes and test intervals set on statistical criteria for each examined attribute so that stability estimates are valid.
quote: Sample size and test intervals based on statistical criteria for each attribute examined to assure valid estimates of stability

statement: Include in the stability program the storage conditions for samples kept for testing.
quote: Storage conditions for samples retained for testing

statement: Include in the stability program test methods that are reliable, meaningful and specific.
quote: Reliable, meaningful, and specific test methods

statement: Include in the stability program testing of the product in the same container-closure system used for the marketed product.
quote: Testing of the drug product in the same container-closure system as that in which the drug product is marketed

statement: For products reconstituted at dispensing, include in the stability program testing at the time of dispensing (as the labeling directs) and after reconstitution.
quote: Testing of drug products for reconstitution at the time of dispensing (as directed in the labeling) as well as after they are reconstituted.

statement: Test an adequate number of batches of each drug product to determine an appropriate expiration date.
quote: An adequate number of batches of each drug product shall be tested to determine an appropriate expiration date

statement: Keep a record of the stability data used to determine expiration dates.
quote: a record of such data shall be maintained

statement: Accelerated studies plus basic stability information on components, drug products and container-closure system may support tentative expiration dates, provided full shelf life studies are not available and are under way.
quote: Accelerated studies, combined with basic stability information on the components, drug products, and container-closure system, may be used to support tentative expiration dates provided full shelf life studies are not available and are being conducted.
condition: full shelf life studies not available and being conducted

statement: Where accelerated data project a tentative expiration date beyond what actual shelf life studies support, continue stability studies, including product testing at appropriate intervals, until the tentative date is verified or the appropriate date is determined.
quote: Where data from accelerated studies are used to project a tentative expiration date that is beyond a date supported by actual shelf life studies, there must be stability studies conducted, including drug product testing at appropriate intervals, until the tentative expiration date is verified or the appropriate expiration date determined.
condition: accelerated data project date beyond shelf life data

statement: For homeopathic products, maintain a written stability assessment based at least on testing or examination for ingredient compatibility and on marketing experience showing no degradation over the normal or expected period of use.
quote: There shall be a written assessment of stability based at least on testing or examination of the drug product for compatibility of the ingredients, and based on marketing experience with the drug product to indicate that there is no degradation of the product for the normal or expected period of use.

statement: For homeopathic products, base the stability evaluation on the same container-closure system used for the marketed product.
quote: Evaluation of stability shall be based on the same container-closure system in which the drug product is being marketed.

statement: Retain batch-associated production, control and distribution records for at least 1 year after batch expiry, or 3 years after distribution for OTC products exempt from expiration dating under 211.137.
quote: Any production, control, or distribution record that is required to be maintained in compliance with this part and is specifically associated with a batch of a drug product shall be retained for at least 1 year after the expiration date of the batch or, in the case of certain OTC drug products lacking expiration dating because they meet the criteria for exemption under § 211.137, 3 years after distribution of the batch.

statement: Keep records for all components, containers, closures and labeling for at least 1 year after expiry, or 3 years after distribution of the last lot using them for OTC products exempt from expiration dating under 211.137.
quote: Records shall be maintained for all components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling for at least 1 year after the expiration date or, in the case of certain OTC drug products lacking expiration dating because they meet the criteria for exemption under § 211.137, 3 years after distribution of the last lot of drug product incorporating the component or using the container, closure, or labeling.

statement: Keep all required records, or copies, readily available for authorized inspection throughout the retention period at the site where the recorded activities took place.
quote: All records required under this part, or copies of such records, shall be readily available for authorized inspection during the retention period at the establishment where the activities described in such records occurred.

statement: Allow required records or their copies to be photocopied or otherwise reproduced during inspection.
quote: These records or copies thereof shall be subject to photocopying or other means of reproduction as part of such inspection.

statement: Required records may be kept as originals or as true copies such as photocopies, microfilm, microfiche or other accurate reproductions.
quote: Records required under this part may be retained either as original records or as true copies such as photocopies, microfilm, microfiche, or other accurate reproductions of the original records.

statement: Where reduction techniques such as microfilming are used, keep suitable reader and photocopying equipment readily available.
quote: Where reduction techniques, such as microfilming, are used, suitable reader and photocopying equipment shall be readily available.

statement: Maintain written records so their data can support an evaluation, at least once a year, of each product's quality standards to decide whether specifications or manufacturing or control procedures need to change.
quote: Written records required by this part shall be maintained so that data therein can be used for evaluating, at least annually, the quality standards of each drug product to determine the need for changes in drug product specifications or manufacturing or control procedures.

statement: Establish and follow written procedures for the annual product quality evaluations.
quote: Written procedures shall be established and followed for such evaluations

statement: Ensure the evaluation procedure provides for reviewing a representative number of batches, approved or rejected, and where applicable their associated records.
quote: A review of a representative number of batches, whether approved or rejected, and, where applicable, records associated with the batch.

statement: Ensure the evaluation procedure provides for reviewing complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged products and investigations under 211.192 for each product.
quote: A review of complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations conducted under § 211.192 for each drug product.

statement: Establish procedures so that responsible officials, if not personally involved or immediately aware, are notified in writing of investigations under 211.198, 211.204 or 211.208, recalls, FDA inspectional observation reports, and FDA GMP regulatory actions.
quote: Procedures shall be established to assure that the responsible officials of the firm, if they are not personally involved in or immediately aware of such actions, are notified in writing of any investigations conducted under §§ 211.198, 211.204, or 211.208 of these regulations, any recalls, reports of inspectional observations issued by the Food and Drug Administration, or any regulatory actions relating to good manufacturing practices brought by the Food and Drug Administration.
condition: officials not personally involved or immediately aware

statement: Have the quality control unit review and approve all production and control records, including packaging and labeling records, for compliance with approved written procedures before a batch is released or distributed.
quote: All drug product production and control records, including those for packaging and labeling, shall be reviewed and approved by the quality control unit to determine compliance with all established, approved written procedures before a batch is released or distributed.

statement: Thoroughly investigate any unexplained discrepancy (including a yield outside the maximum or minimum percentage of theoretical set in master records) or any failure of a batch or its components to meet specifications, even if the batch has been distributed.
quote: Any unexplained discrepancy (including a percentage of theoretical yield exceeding the maximum or minimum percentages established in master production and control records) or the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications shall be thoroughly investigated, whether or not the batch has already been distributed.

statement: Extend the investigation to other batches of the same product and to other products that may be associated with the failure or discrepancy.
quote: The investigation shall extend to other batches of the same drug product and other drug products that may have been associated with the specific failure or discrepancy.

statement: Make a written record of each investigation including its conclusions and follow-up.
quote: A written record of the investigation shall be made and shall include the conclusions and followup.
